title: Selling a home Pflugerville, TX is HARD! But not when it looks like this
description: This home sits in a premium section of Park at Blackhawk — a short walk to the large community fitness center, two neighborhood parks, fishing ponds, and wide open green spaces. Park at Blackhawk also includes a resort-style pool, playground, and street-lit sidewalks throughout. This 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom, 3,215-square-foot two-story was built in 2021 by Coventry Homes. Step through the front door into a long entry hall that opens to a catwalk above before the living room reveals itself — ceiling soaring past the second floor in a dramatic open volume that anchors the entire main level. The open-concept layout connects the living area to a gourmet kitchen with granite countertops, quartz island, gas range, stainless steel appliances, built-in microwave, and butler's pantry. A dedicated home office, formal dining room, and main-level laundry round out the first floor. The primary suite is also on the main level with an upgraded walk-in closet, soaking tub, separate shower, and dual vanity. Upstairs, there's both an oversized game room and media room, two additional bedrooms, and two full quartz bathrooms — enough space for everyone to have their own zone. The 2.5-car oversized garage adds extra storage and flex capacity. A permanent Trimlight LED exterior lighting system is also included, providing programmable, app-controlled, accent lighting for year-round curb appeal and no seasonal installation. Out back, a covered patio, gas grill hookup, in-ground sprinkler system, and fully fenced private yard. Short commute to the Tesla Gigafactory, with easy access to Costco, HEB, Typhoon Texas, and the Blackhawk Golf Club.
